sloka: स तस्य शृङ्गं सनगं सनागं सकाञ्चनं धातुसहस्रजुष्टम्।विकीर्णकूटज्वलिताग्रसानुं प्रगृह्य वेगात् सहसोन्ममाथ ।। ६.७४.६७ ।।
transliteration: sa tasya śṛṅgaṁ sanagaṁ sanāgaṁ sakāñcanaṁ dhātusahasrajuṣṭam।vikīrṇakūṭajvalitāgrasānuṁ pragṛhya vegāt sahasonmamātha ।। 6.74.67 ।।

translations.english: Striking terror among Devatas and demons and leaders inhabiting the world, uprooting the mountain he hurried at Garuda's speed into the sky praised by aerial creatures.
